preconditions.description: The number of balls is between 2 and 2 * 10^5, inclusive.
The number of swaps is between 1 and 2 * 10^5, inclusive.
The initial position of the special ball is between 1 and n, inclusive.
Each swap involves balls numbered between 1 and n, inclusive.
No swap swaps a ball with itself.

postconditions.description: The output is a list of n integers.

postconditions.expression: all(output[i] == -1 or output[i] >= 0 for i in range(n))
postconditions.description: Each output value is either -1 (if the special ball cannot be moved to the target position) or a non-negative integer (the minimum number of swaps that need to be faked to move the special ball to the target position).
